Notably, Augermu accepts them in exchange for , which are required to unlock upgrades at the Hourglass of Horrific Visions. Divine Endowment is a buff granted as a reward for completing Ten Pounds of Flesh or its repeatable follow-ups, Blessings From Above and Satyrical Offerings. By repeating these quests periodically, it is possible to maintain the health boost throughout the entire Desolace storyline, at the cost of re-farming Satyr Flesh from the satyr of Sargeron each time it needs to be refreshed. This buff is completely removed upon leaving the Desolace, and is not reapplied when re-entering the zone.

Dornic was a titan watcher appointed by Archaedas, alongside Galan to oversee the earthen of Khaz Algar. Dornic's arrival was met with enthusiasm and celebration by the earthen, they even proposed to name the fortress they were building after him and his sister. However, in the absence of Archaedas, Dornic turned out to be a tyrannical and oppressive leader. He imposed unreasonable demands, and punished the earthen harshly, including deactivating them at his discretion. According to earthen plays he ordered production rates to be tripled and also, when he decided he needed only one general, made his earthen generals fight among each other over which should remain.
